heroSub: I'm Rafael. I build whole web systems, from the PostgreSQL table to the button you click. I run Fenrys Tech, I made Atlanteon, and in my spare time I model flying saucers in Blender.
stackTitle: Database to browser, layer by layer.
stackSub: Scroll and follow a data packet climbing up the stack I work with.
projAtlDesc: A training platform for gyms, personal trainers and their students. From the plan a trainer builds to the weight on every set, with progress history, body assessments and trainer–student chat.
projAtlFact1: Hercules, an AI that builds, adjusts and periodizes workouts from the student's history, using OpenAI function calling.
projAtlFact2: Real-time trainer–student chat, with typing indicators and push notifications.
projAtlFact3: Web and Android app from the same React codebase, via Capacitor.
exp1Desc1: Automated in Oracle APEX the workflows researchers and staff used to do by hand.
exp1Desc2: Looked after the institutional WordPress sites: accessibility, performance and visual identity.
exp1Desc3: Supported researchers and staff, from lost access to resolved incident.
exp2Desc1: I build and maintain the web systems the legislative body uses every day, in Ruby on Rails.
exp2Desc2: I build REST APIs and wire up the institution's data sources.
exp2Desc3: I take legacy features and make them more consistent and easier to use.
contactSub: A job, a project, or just to talk about flying saucers: the inbox is open.
footerMade: Handmade in Goiânia with Next.js, Three.js and a flying saucer modelled in Blender.
aboutText: I'm a software engineer in Goiânia, Brazil, and the CEO of Fenrys Tech, a software studio that turns ideas into products. On my own I built Atlanteon, a training platform that's already live, and I model things in 3D in Blender, that saucer included. Day to day I also build web systems at the Legislative Assembly, after starting out at FAPEG automating workflows in Oracle APEX.
fenrysTitle: I also run a software studio.
fenrysDesc: Fenrys Tech turns ideas into real technology: tailor-made digital products for companies, startups and shops that want to grow with intelligence and speed.
fenrysSvc1d: Platforms, admin panels, ERPs and CRMs, built to fit.
fenrysSvc3d: Generative AI, chatbots and LLM automation.
fenrysSvc4d: Online stores with payments, shipping and stock wired in.
fenrysSvc6d: Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and automated deploys.
